description: This file defines two functions, Release and Releases, which generate HTML elements representing software release information, including version links and download URLs, based on provided properties.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Generates a list of release links or labels, formatted with optional CSS classes and styles, based on versions and URLs provided.

methods.name: Releases
methods.description: Generates a section with multiple release listings, including tags and download links for different platforms, based on input properties.
